notes: Thresholds for the V1 scanners. Change a number here, or change a rule in jobs/scanners.py, and bump the version. v2: sector_trend only fires on the day the condition becomes true.

liquidity._comment: Ignore stocks trading under Rs 1 crore a day on average: too thin to act on.

consolidation_breakout._comment: Price leaves a range it stayed inside for 60+ days, on above-average volume.

new_high_breakout._comment: Within 0.5% of the 52-week high, with the 30-week average rising.

volume_expansion._comment: Volume at least 3x its 20-day average, price not down.

price_volume_surge._comment: Price up 4%+ with volume at least twice normal (the methodology's first-level screen).

sector_trend._comment: Stock above its 30-week average, in a sector beating the market and ranked in the top 20% of sectors. Only on the day this becomes true.
